name: Nollm Memory
description: Nollm native active memory provider for OpenClaw. Reuses the W1 native companion store for automatic prepare/recall and deterministic explicit capture.

pythonExecutable.description: Absolute path to the Python interpreter used to run the Nollm active sidecar.

pythonArgs.description: Discrete argv values passed to the Python interpreter before the sidecar script.

nollmRepoRoot.description: Absolute path to the Nollm repository.

workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path to the OpenClaw workspace root.

nativeStoreRoot.description: Absolute path to the native companion store directory (e.g. <workspace>/.nollm-memory/native-companion-v1).

trialRoot.description: Absolute path to the active-trials directory. Defaults to <nativeStoreRoot>/../active-trials.

maxContextCharacters.description: Maximum characters of rendered memory context injected per turn.

captureMode.description: W2 active capture mode: deterministic explicit stable-sentence promotion only.

trialMode.description: W2 trial mode: local-only redacted operator metrics.
